desc: Dark and resinous: saffron and black truffle over vanilla, patchouli and oud, with a floral touch of crocus.

name: Tres Nuit
desc: Lemon, verbena and iris feel crisp and a little powdery. Lavender, spice and violet sit in the heart, with ambergris and sandalwood underneath.

name: Good Girl Supreme
desc: Wild berries add a bright, fruity top to jasmine and orange blossom, resting on creamy tonka bean and vetiver.

name: Virgin Island Water
desc: Bergamot, lime and mandarin sparkle over hibiscus, ylang-ylang and jasmine. A creamy floral heart settles into soft musk and light wood.

name: Rien
desc: A dry, dark leather: black pepper, saffron-leather and incense open it, leather, iris and cistus sit in the heart, and patchouli, vetiver and tree moss ground it.

name: A Drop d'Issey
desc: Almond milk and rose open soft, followed by lilac, jasmine and orange blossom. Musk, vanilla and cedarwood make a creamy, warm base.

name: Wonderlust Sublime
desc: Orange blossom, carnation and Tahitian tiare flower form a creamy white-floral bouquet that settles into an amber warmth.

name: Squid
desc: A salty, inky marine scent: pink pepper and a sun-lotion note open it, a black-ink accord and opoponax follow, and ambergris, benzoin and musk close it.

name: Musc Infini
desc: A soft, powdery musk: bergamot, grapefruit and ambrette brighten the start, rose and patchouli follow, and benzoin, vanilla and tonka bean make it cozy.

name: Red Roses
desc: Rose is the centre here, lifted by a squeeze of lemon and rounded with a drop of honey. Fresh, sweet and softly petalled.

name: Cheap & Chic
desc: Yuzu, orange and bergamot sparkle above peony, violet, water lily and rose. The base is soft with iris, sandalwood, tonka and vanilla.

name: Megamare
desc: Bergamot and citron open over a briny blend of seaweed, calone and hedione, drying to a mineral base of ambroxan, cedar and musk.

name: Tabac Blond
desc: A leathery, spiced floral that opens with clove and carnation, moves through ylang and rose, and settles on patchouli and leather.

name: Potion for Women
desc: Violet, blackberry and bergamot meet jasmine, rose and a green note of rhubarb. Patchouli, ginger, musk and vanilla keep the base warm and soft.

name: Pi
desc: Tangerine and pine give a crisp, resinous opening. Ironwood and benzoin follow, drying down to a smooth, woody warmth.

name: Le Male Elixir
desc: Lavender is warm and herbal over a heart of tonka bean. Benzoin brings a sweet, resinous depth.

name: Ricci Ricci
desc: Bergamot, rhubarb and a fruity accord open onto rose and tuberose, drying down to patchouli and sandalwood.

name: Un Matin d'Orage
desc: A stormy white floral: shiso and ginger start it, tuberose, gardenia and nutmeg bloom in the middle, and guaiac wood, myrrh and vanilla close it.

name: Chrome Extreme
desc: Green mandarin and a salty sea accord open a bright, clean scent; juniper adds a cool, resinous edge before amber and soft cashmere settle underneath.

name: Bibliothèque
desc: Plum and cinnamon open to leather and violet, over birch wood, patchouli and vanilla, like old paper and shelves.

name: Roses de Chloé
desc: Damask rose leads, brightened by bergamot and lychee and softened with peach and magnolia. Cedar and white musk give the finish a gentle, woody hush.

name: Arso
desc: A dark, resinous woody scent: cedar wood and leather lead into frankincense and pine resin.

name: Davidoff Adventure
desc: Bergamot, lemon and mandarin meet tea, pepper and maté, then sesame and spice. Cedarwood, musk and vetiver provide an earthy base.

name: Bamboo
desc: Orange blossom and bergamot lift a creamy heart of ylang-ylang, lily and jasmine. Sandalwood and vanilla leave a sweet, soft finish.

name: Kalan
desc: Citrus and herbs on a mossy woody base: blood orange and black pepper, then lavender, wormwood and orange blossom, with tonka and cedarwood beneath.

name: Candy Kiss
desc: Musk threads through every stage, with orange blossom at the heart and vanilla at the base. A soft, clean, skin-close sweetness.

name: Attimo
desc: Pear and lotus open onto a creamy trio of frangipani, gardenia and peony, with patchouli, musk and Virginia cedar to close.

name: Anaïs Anaïs
desc: Hyacinth and honeysuckle give way to a creamy bouquet of jasmine, lily of the valley and rose, settling into mossy oakmoss, vetiver and a hint of blackcurrant.

name: Hugo Woman
desc: Blackberry, cut grass and Italian mandarin lead into black tea, jasmine, plum and iris, drying to amber, cedar and sandalwood.

name: Psychédélique
desc: A patchouli-led scent with citrus on top, cistus, amber, geranium and rose in the middle, and vanilla and musk in the base.

name: Sweet Oriental Dream
desc: A short, sweet pyramid: rose on top, almond and honey in the middle, vanilla beneath. Simple and gourmand, with a honeyed, nutty softness around the floral note.

name: Ta'if
desc: A spiced rose: pink pepper, saffron and dates open to rose, freesia and orange flower, finishing on vanilla, broom and amber.

name: Joy by Dior
desc: Bergamot and tangerine open onto Grasse rose and jasmine. Sandalwood, cedar and white musk follow, with a touch of patchouli for depth.

name: Lady Vengeance
desc: An aromatic floral with bergamot and lavender up front, rose and patchouli in the middle, and a clean, skin-like ambroxan base.

name: Sicily
desc: Citrus, apple and peach give way to a floral heart of jasmine, rose and violet, then settle into creamy sandalwood and soft musk.

name: Signature
desc: Mandarin, peony and orchid brighten a creamy heart of vanilla, magnolia and ylang-ylang, softened by musk, amber and benzoin.

name: Born in Roma Extradose
desc: Blackcurrant opens tart and fruity, then a boozy heart of rum. Vanilla rounds everything into a warm, sweet finish.

name: Poême
desc: Lychee and poppy open lightly fruity. Orange blossom, mimosa and jasmine follow, ending in a powdery, creamy vanilla base.

name: Suède et Safran
desc: A short, soft leather scent: ambrette seed and saffron on top, suede and ginger in the heart, finished with musk and leather. Warm, smooth and lightly spicy.

name: Erawan
desc: A gourmand fougère that pairs green petitgrain and clary sage with hay, vetiver and vanilla, then settles on tonka bean, cedarwood and oakmoss for a calm, woody-sweet finish.

name: Scandal Pour Homme
desc: A fresh fougère: citrus, lavender and herbs open it, lily of the valley and rose follow, and a long woody, mossy, spiced base of vetiver, cedar and ambergris.

name: Tuxedo
desc: Pepper and cardamom sharpen a base of patchouli and ambergris. Earthy, spicy and warm, it reads like dark tailoring rather than anything sweet.

name: Velvet Desert Oud
desc: Tobacco and incense smoulder first, then saffron, amber and leather. Oud and musk bring a deep, resinous warmth.

name: La Petite Robe Noire
desc: Black cherry and black rose carry a sweet, shadowy glow with almonds, while smoked tea, licorice, patchouli and tonka linger at the base.

name: Angel Elixir
desc: Creamy golden florals sit in warm amber and bourbon vanilla. Rich and enveloping.

name: Narciso Poudrée
desc: Rose and jasmine take a powdery turn over a soft musk heart, with vetiver and cedar wood keeping the base dry and smooth.

name: Hawas for Him
desc: Apple, lemon and bergamot with a pinch of cinnamon; orange blossom, cardamom and plum follow, finishing on patchouli, grey amber, driftwood and musk.

name: Gold Rose Oudh
desc: Rose and oud with a smoky, sandy edge: bergamot, fir, embers and sand open, rose, patchouli and black pepper follow, and oud, amber, sandalwood, musk and honey close.

name: Truth
desc: A clean mix of bergamot, lemon and bamboo meets peony, lily and mimosa. Sandalwood, vetiver and a soft musk and vanilla base keep it calm.

name: Monsieur
desc: A smooth woody-amber scent: mandarin and rum open to patchouli, then cedar, suede and incense.

name: Oud Mood
desc: Rose, saffron and pimento open spiced and floral, giving way to oud, caramel and patchouli. Amber, incense and musk wrap a resinous base.

name: Honey
desc: Pear and mandarin open juicy, followed by orange blossom, peach, apricot and honeysuckle. Honey, vanilla and wood make a sweet, creamy finish.

name: Phi Une Rose de Kandahar
desc: A dark, spiced rose: apricot, cinnamon and bitter almond lead to Afghan and Bulgarian rose, and a long base of tobacco, patchouli, vanilla and ambergris.

name: Craze Man
desc: A clean, soapy oriental-fougere: heliotrope, cumin and bergamot open, bitter almond, lavender, jasmine and sage form the heart, and vanilla, amber and sandalwood close.

name: Bad Boy Cobalt
desc: Pink pepper and lavender lead to geranium and plum. Mushroom, vetiver and cedarwood make a distinctly earthy, herbal base.

name: Love in White
desc: Orange opens softly over a powdery heart of iris, daffodil and magnolia. Vanilla, ambergris and sandalwood finish it warm and gently creamy.

name: Remarkable People
desc: A sparkling, spiced scent: grapefruit, a champagne accord and cardamom lead to jasmine, curry and black pepper, with labdanum, sandalwood and a woody-amber note beneath.

name: Shaghaf Oud
desc: An oriental oud with a gourmand streak: saffron opens it, rose and praline soften the heart around the oud, and vanilla rounds off a warm, golden base.

name: Rhinoceros
desc: A smoky, boozy leather: pink pepper, whiskey, coffee and rum open it, leather, incense, tobacco and flouve follow, and oud, patchouli, oakmoss and amber give a dry base.

name: Turathi Electric
desc: Bergamot, grapefruit, pear and mandarin spark over apple, cedarwood and orange blossom. Vanilla, amber, musk and ambroxan finish it warm and fresh.

name: Vetiver Moloko
desc: A milky vetiver: bergamot and rose open it, a creamy accord and cypress sit in the middle, then vetiver, vanilla and amyris wood.

name: Amour
desc: White tea and rice give a soft, milky start. Cherry blossom, frangipani and heliotrope turn powdery over frankincense, vanilla and white musk.

name: Funny!
desc: Pink pepper, bitter orange and red currant start bright, with violet, jasmine, peony and tea. Amber, cedarwood, oakmoss and musk ground a fresh floral.

name: Viride
desc: Artemisia and lavender are bitter and herbal, over jasmine. Cedarwood, juniper, fir balsam and tobacco give a green, smoky depth.

name: Invictus Victory
desc: Lemon and pink peppercorns start crisp, then incense and lavender lead to a warm, resinous finish of tonka bean and amber.

name: Néroli Amara
desc: Lime, lemon, orange and red pepper are zesty and bright, with cypress and pepper in the heart. Neroli closes it clean and green.

name: Amber Oud Gold Edition
desc: Melon and pineapple glow over a sweet gourmand accord, with amber, vanilla and soft musk rounding out the warmth.

name: Bellodgia
desc: A classic spicy floral built on carnation and clove, with rose in the middle and a soft base of musk and sandalwood.

name: Gentleman Réserve Privée
desc: Whisky and bergamot lead to a sweet, powdery heart of chestnut, iris and benzoin, grounded by cedarwood, vetiver and patchouli.

name: Divine
desc: Calypsone, pink pepper and bergamot open airy, then lily, jasmine and ylang-ylang. Meringue, patchouli and musk end soft, sweet and creamy.

name: Néroli 36
desc: Orange blossom, mandarin and aldehydes open sparkling, then jasmine and rose bloom. Tonka bean, musk and vanilla leave a creamy, sweet warmth.

name: L'Extase
desc: Pink pepper, peach and pear lead into rose, jasmine and raspberry. Benzoin, cedar, musk and amber leave a creamy, warm trail.

name: Acqua di Gioia
desc: Mint, lemon and a green watery accord feel cool and clean, followed by pink pepper, jasmine sambac and peony. Cedarwood, labdanum and brown sugar warm the close.

name: The Most Wanted Parfum
desc: Ginger gives a spiced start over a woody heart. Vanilla lends a sweet, warm finish.

name: Sundazed
desc: Lemon and mandarin shine first, followed by neroli and jasmine sambac. Musk closes it with a soft, creamy, sunlit finish.

name: Fumidus
desc: Vetiver opens dry and earthy, with birch adding a smoky edge. Vetiver returns at the base for a smoky depth.

name: El Born
desc: Lemon, bergamot and honey open bright, with fig, heliotrope and jasmine in the heart. Vanilla, sandalwood and musk give a warm, resinous base.

name: Bloom Nettare di Fiori
desc: Tuberose and jasmine take a rich, creamy turn with rose and ginger, set on musk, patchouli and the honeyed scent of osmanthus.

name: Replica Bubble Bath
desc: A clean, soapy scent that opens with soap bubbles, pink pepper and bergamot, moves through lavender, rose and jasmine, and settles on patchouli, coconut milk and white musks.

name: Haltane
desc: Aromatic and dark: bergamot and pink pepper give way to saffron, praline and lavender, ending in oud, patchouli, vetiver and leather.

name: Luna
desc: Bergamot, lemon and orange sparkle, followed by rose, jasmine and juniper. Fir balsam, musk and ambergris end cool and resinous.

name: Infusion de Vétiver
desc: Bergamot brightens a spiced heart of ginger and cardamom. Vetiver anchors it with a dry, earthy, warm finish.

name: Pour Homme
desc: Darjeeling tea and water lily give a clear, airy start. Cardamom and guaiac wood add a dry spice, resting on a quiet bed of musk and amber.

name: Amor Amor
desc: Tangerine, bergamot and blackcurrant leaves sparkle over lily of the valley, rose and apricot, easing into a vanilla, tonka and musk base with cedar.

name: Boss Alive
desc: Apple, plum and blackcurrant meet a touch of cinnamon, then Indian jasmine and Madagascar vanilla. Cedar, sandalwood and olive tree wood finish it.

name: Ambre Premier
desc: A sweet amber: spices and candied orange open it, rose forms the heart, and amber, patchouli, musk and vanilla give a warm, lasting base.

name: Amber Rouge
desc: Jasmine and orange open into saffron and a sweet praline note, finishing with amber, a briny trace of algae and mossy oakmoss.

name: Tolu
desc: A resinous amber scent: juniper, orange blossom and clary sage lead to orchid, geranium and lily of the valley, resting on tolu resin, tonka, frankincense and amber.

name: Dylan Turquoise
desc: Tangerine, lemon and pink pepper sparkle over currant buds, jasmine and freesia, ending on cedar wood, musk and clearwood.

name: Pasha Edition Noire
desc: Citrus brightens an amber heart, and cedarwood gives a dry, warm finish. Simple, glowing and quietly woody.

name: Higher
desc: Basil and pear give a green, juicy start. Cardamom brings a dry spice, and Virginia cedar closes the scent in a clean, woody line.

name: Escentric 02
desc: A fresh scent of ginger, citrus and juniper over orris and a hedione glow, grounded by ambroxan, musk, vetiver and tonka.

name: Jermyn Street
desc: A fresh, herbal gentleman's scent: bergamot, violet and green vetiver lead into coriander, juniper and armoise, finishing on amber, cedar and musk.

name: Miss Charming
desc: A sweet, fruity rose: Moroccan rose over wild strawberry, resting on soft musks.

name: Starwalker
desc: Bamboo, bergamot and mandarin feel airy, over elemi, nutmeg and ginger. Amber and sandalwood make a warm, spiced finish.

name: Soir de Lune
desc: Citrus and a touch of nutmeg and pepper open onto powdery iris, rose and mimosa, then warm into honeyed sandalwood and musk.

name: Playing with the Devil
desc: Blood orange and blackcurrant are juicy and tart, over pimento and rose. Sandalwood supports a fruity, spiced floral that feels playful.

name: Tuberóza
desc: A tuberose-led white floral with ylang ylang, sweet orange and orange blossom on top, gardenia, jasmine and marigold in the heart, and amberwood, vetiver, sandalwood and musk below.

name: Le Pavillon d'Or
desc: A woody aromatic scent: cool mint and thyme open it, fig leaf and heliotrope sit in the middle, and frankincense, oak and sandalwood give a resinous, dry base.

name: Oligarch
desc: Bergamot, lavender, lime and thyme open sharp and aromatic, with orange blossom, jasmine, coconut and lily. Cut grass, galbanum, patchouli and cedarwood give a green, woody base.

name: Guidance
desc: Pear, frankincense and hazelnut lead into saffron, rose and osmanthus. Labdanum, sandalwood, ambergris and vanilla make a warm, sweet and woody close.

name: Idylle
desc: Lily, peony, freesia and white lilac open as a soft bouquet, around jasmine and Bulgarian rose, with patchouli and white musk below.

name: Ocean Leather
desc: A salty, fresh leather: lemon, mandarin and pink pepper start it, clary sage and an aquatic accord run through the middle, and vetiver, marine leather and labdanum finish.

name: Alien Man
desc: Lemon, mint and dill open a bright, herbal top over lavender, thyme and anise. Leather, osmanthus and geranium lead to a soft base of vanilla, amber and cashmeran.

name: Narciso Rouge
desc: Bulgarian rose and red iris sit over a heart of musk. Tonka, vetiver and cedar wood give a powdery, sweet-woody finish.

name: Hawas Ice
desc: Apple, lemon and bergamot with a thread of anise run into plum and orange blossom, settling on moss, amber, musk and driftwood.

name: Evoke
desc: A classic floral-chypre feel: bergamot and pink pepper over rose, jasmine and iris, with oakmoss, patchouli and vanilla underneath.

name: Synthetic Jungle
desc: Basil and lily of the valley bring a green, dewy freshness. Jasmine flows into patchouli, leaving an earthy, creamy trail.

name: Quelques Fleurs L'Original
desc: A classic white-floral bouquet opens through green bergamot and herbs. Oakmoss, iris and musk end powdery.

name: Ra'ed Silver
desc: Tangerine and spices open into cinnamon, clove and saffron. Amber, ambergris, leather and agar wood give a rich, resinous warmth.

name: Divine Decadence
desc: Orange blossom, champagne and bergamot sparkle, then honeysuckle, gardenia and hydrangea bloom. Amber, saffron and vanilla keep it creamy and warm.

name: Spicebomb Night Vision
desc: Green apple, grapefruit and cardamom sharpen the bergamot opening, with clary sage, geranium, rosemary and lavandin, and roasted almond, tonka and cedar below.

name: Eternia
desc: Grapefruit, orange and pepper open brightly, then vetiver and frankincense bring a smoky resin. Saffron and sage close it, spiced and warm.

name: 212 Heroes
desc: Mandarin and raspberry brighten a heart of jasmine and orange blossom. Sandalwood and cedarwood add a creamy, woody calm.

name: Spice and Wood
desc: Bergamot, lemon and apple brighten a dry heart of clove, pimento, birch and patchouli. Iris, cedar, musk and oak moss anchor the base.

name: Eau des Sens
desc: Orange blossom and bitter orange mingle with the green, gin-like note of juniper berries, then dry out to patchouli and angelica.

name: Dangerous Complicity
desc: A tropical, sweet-spiced scent: rum, ginger and coconut open it, osmanthus, jasmine and ylang ylang follow, and patchouli, sandalwood and a woody-amber note close.

name: Ambassador for Men
desc: Mandarin, apple and cardamom give a bright start, with lavender and pepper in the middle, then earthy vetiver, oakmoss and teak wood under a layer of vanilla.

name: Amethyst
desc: Raspberry, blackberry and blackcurrant make a dark fruit opening, with ylang-ylang, peony and rose. Wood, musk and vanilla finish sweet.

name: Layali
desc: A fruity floral with oud at its centre: dark plum, black currant and orange flower open, ylang ylang, rose and jasmine form the heart, and oud with amber closes it.

name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
desc: A resinous, leathery scent: bergamot, pepper, fir and laurel lead into rich flowers, then cade, resins, civet, leather, patchouli and vanilla form the base.

name: Turathi Homme
desc: Coriander, violet leaf and bergamot open crisp, then rose and pepper. Vanilla, patchouli and amber add a warm, spiced softness.

name: Madawi
desc: Pineapple brings a juicy brightness to a creamy orange blossom heart, which settles on earthy patchouli.

name: Blue Talisman
desc: A fresh, airy musk with juicy pear, ginger and citrus on top, orange blossom in the heart, and a clean, woody-musky base.

name: Oud & Bergamot
desc: Bergamot's bright peel gives way to cedarwood and a smooth, resinous oud, so a fresh start moves slowly into dark wood.

name: Flower by Kenzo Poppy Bouquet
desc: Pear opens lightly, leading into rose and gardenia. A creamy, woody base lets the bouquet linger softly.

name: Bergamask
desc: Bergamot and lemon sparkle, followed by lily of the valley, lavender and orange blossom. Cedarwood, musk and tonka bean keep it soft and fresh.

name: L'Interdit Rouge
desc: Blood orange and ginger lift a creamy heart of orange blossom, jasmine and pimento, which settles on patchouli and sandalwood.

name: Gaultier Divine
desc: Pink berry and bergamot lift a heart of lily, jasmine and ylang ylang. Meringue, patchouli and musk make the base airy and sweet.

name: Black
desc: Basil, mint and ginger open sharp and cool, then violet and cedarwood lead to a smoky base of frankincense, leather and musk.

name: Rose Pompon
desc: A fruity rose: raspberry, blackcurrant and pink pepper open it, Bulgarian and Taif rose with violet make the heart, and patchouli with white musk carries the base.

name: Chrome United
desc: Pepper, coriander and bergamot give a crisp, spiced start. Violet leaves and black tea add a cool green note before cedar and white musk.

name: Flowerhead
desc: Bright and floral: angelica, lingonberry and lemon, then tuberose, rose and jasmine sambac over fresh amber and suede.

name: Eden Sparkling Lychee 39
desc: Blackcurrant, lemon, lychee and apple sparkle over rose, lilac and jasmine sambac. Amber, cedarwood, musk and vanilla give a warm, soft base.

name: Eau de Rochas
desc: A fresh, summery citrus chypre: bergamot, mandarin, lemon and verbena open onto a floral core of narcissus and jasmine plus lily of the valley, with oak moss, myrrh and patchouli beneath.

name: This is Her!
desc: Jasmine glows against a sweet, nutty heart of chestnut and vanilla, drying to a smooth sandalwood base.

name: Tardes
desc: Almond and geranium open sweet, with plum and cedarwood in the heart. Tonka bean and heliotrope give a soft, warm finish.

name: Esprit du Tigre
desc: A sharp, minty-spiced scent: camphor and mints cool the opening, cardamom, clove and black pepper add heat, and vetiver and cinnamon close it.

name: Replica Coffee Break
desc: A café-inspired scent: coffee, red apple and lemon, then lavender, spearmint and orange flower, finishing on milk mousse, sandalwood and cedarwood. Comforting, creamy and lightly herbal.

name: Juniper Sling
desc: Juniper berries and orange meet cinnamon and cardamom, then leather, orris and pepper. Vetiver, cherry, brown sugar and ambrox sweeten the ending.

name: Infusion de Fleur d'Oranger
desc: Neroli and orange blossom feel bright and creamy, deepening with jasmine and sandalwood. A smooth, woody floral that stays serene.

name: Signorina Libera
desc: Pear, bergamot and elemi are bright, with iris, rose and plum in the heart. Sugar, cashmere wood and ambroxan make a powdery, soft base.

name: Blu Mediterraneo Bergamotto di Calabria
desc: Calabrian bergamot and citron shine over cedarwood and red ginger, then ease into a quiet finish of vetiver, benzoin and musk.

name: Cloud
desc: A soft gourmand: lavender, pear and bergamot open lightly, coconut, praline and vanilla orchid make a creamy heart, and a cashmere base keeps it plush.

name: Eau Parfumée au Thé Vert
desc: Bergamot, shiso and neroli feel green and light, with tea and violet at the heart. Iris and musk lend a powdery, quiet finish.

name: Noa
desc: Peach and freesia over fresh green leaves lead into soft lily and jasmine, then a warm, creamy base of vanilla, sandalwood and tonka bean with a trace of coffee.

name: Boss Bottled Night
desc: Birch and lavender are dry and smoky, with a violet heart. Woody notes and musk keep it powdery and calm.

name: Chocolate Greedy
desc: A dessert-like blend where bitter orange gives way to cacao and vanilla, finishing on coffee bean and tonka. Sweet, roasted and rich, with a gourmand warmth throughout.

name: Osmanthus
desc: A fruity-floral scent: pomelo, davana and pimento open onto osmanthus, water lily and jasmine over cedarwood, labdanum, musk and vetiver.

name: Versense
desc: Bergamot, fig, mandarin and pear make a juicy citrus opening. Lily, jasmine and cardamom flow into sandalwood, cedarwood and musk.

name: Eilish
desc: Sugared red berries and mandarin lead to rose, chocolate and a touch of spice, melting into amber, tonka bean and soft musk.

name: Escentric 03
desc: Ginger, lime and pepper are bright and spiced, with iris, jasmine and tea. Vetiver, musk, sandalwood and cedarwood add a woody, clean base.

name: Moscow Mule
desc: A sparkling citrus-and-ginger scent: bergamot, lime and ginger over jasmine and apple, with a clean musky-amber finish.

name: Legend Night
desc: A dark, sweet-aromatic fragrance with cardamom, mint and clary sage on top, apple, lavender and violet in the heart, and a vanilla, musk, patchouli and vetiver base.

name: Eau de Campagne
desc: A garden after rain: bergamot, basil and cut grass sharpen a green heart of tomato leaf and jasmine, grounded by oakmoss, vetiver and patchouli.

name: Rolling in Love
desc: A soft, powdery floral-musk: almond milk and ambrette open it, iris and freesia sit in the heart, and musk, tonka bean and tuberose make a creamy base.

name: Voyage
desc: Crisp apple and green leaves meet water lily and mimosa, then dry down through cedarwood, oakmoss and amber with a clean musk.

name: Zenne
desc: Grapefruit, blackcurrant and rhubarb give a tart, juicy start. Turkish rose, gardenia and sandalwood follow, ending on vanilla, ambergris and musk for a creamy, warm finish.

name: Oceania
desc: A fresh, herbal, mossy scent: many citrus and herb notes open it, geranium and jasmine make the heart, and galbanum, vetiver, cedar, vanilla and musk finish.

name: Journey Man
desc: A bright citrus-and-spice opening of Sichuan pepper, bergamot and cardamom leads to juniper, frankincense and tobacco, ending in a leathery, sweet-woody base with tonka and cypriol.

name: Velvet Tender Oud
desc: Leather opens against a rose heart, with oud beneath. Floral, smoky and resinous.

name: Lalibela
desc: Rose, patchouli oil and incense: a dark, earthy floral that smolders softly, with a smoky, resinous undertone.

name: Alien Hypersense
desc: Green mandarin and a pear accord brighten jasmine sambac, which sits above a woody, warm cashmeran base.

name: For Her Eau de Parfum
desc: Peach and rose are soft and fruity, set over a heart of musk. Patchouli and amber add an earthy warmth.

name: Polo Double Black
desc: Pepper and mango open spicy and juicy, with nutmeg and coffee at the heart. Juniper, wood and cardamom give a dark, warm base.

name: La Yuqawam
desc: Thyme and saffron meet a bright raspberry edge, then smoke through frankincense into a dry base of leather, suede and amber.

name: Cheirosa 62
desc: Pistachio and almond lead into a soft heliotrope and jasmine heart, then pool into vanilla, caramel and creamy sandalwood.

name: Ursa
desc: Nutmeg, elemi, dried fruits and rum open rich and boozy. Frankincense, tobacco and vetiver deepen into vanilla, leather and oud.

name: Amber Wood
desc: Lavender, cardamom and a crisp apple lead to cedarwood and powdery iris, drying down into warm amber and patchouli.

name: Pacific Lime
desc: Lime, mint and lemon are cool and zesty, softened by coconut. Musk makes a clean, sweet finish.

name: Mayar
desc: A sweet fruity floral opening with raspberry, litchi and black currant, a rose and magnolia heart, and a soft amber and patchouli base.

name: Spicebomb Dark Leather
desc: Pepper and nutmeg give way to incense and cinnamon, then leather and tobacco. A dark, smoky spice with a resinous warmth that lingers.

name: Island Bliss
desc: Tropical and creamy: wild berries and green notes open, coconut, orange blossom, lactones and water lily follow, finishing on vanilla, tonka and musk.

name: 212 VIP Black
desc: Absinthe and lavender feel cool and herbal, with leather adding a smoky edge before a sweet, soft base of vanilla and musk.

name: Bois du Portugal
desc: Bergamot and lavender lead into cedarwood, then sandalwood, vetiver and ambergris. A fresh, herbal woodiness that stays composed and dry.

name: Like This
desc: A spiced, golden scent: mandarin, ginger and a pumpkin accord open it, immortelle, neroli and rose form the heart, and vetiver, heliotrope and musk soften it.

name: Ambassador Intense
desc: Cardamom, nutmeg and pink pepper spice a heart of raspberry, caramel and jasmine, deepening into tonka bean, vanilla, leather and labdanum.

name: Glow
desc: Orange blossom and neroli float over a creamy heart of jasmine, rose and tuberose, resting on sandalwood, amber, vanilla and a powdery iris trace.

name: Perles de Lalique
desc: Rose and iris open soft, with pepper and patchouli in the heart. Cashmere wood leaves a powdery, earthy finish.

name: Kashkha
desc: A fruity, spicy oud: bergamot, apple and cinnamon open it sharply, saffron, cardamom and oud follow, and cedarwood, amber and musk give a smooth, warm finish.

name: Camel
desc: A desert-inspired scent: dried fruit, date and frankincense open it, then amber, cinnamon, incense and floral notes, ending on oud, sandalwood and vanilla.

name: Amber Sky
desc: A sweet, woody amber: coriander seed and bergamot open it, geranium and nutmeg add warmth, and cedar, sandalwood, vanilla and tonka bean fill the base.

name: Oud Silk Mood
desc: Rose and oud meet at the start, resinous and floral together. Chamomile softens the heart and papyrus adds a dry, woody finish.

name: Bergamote
desc: A sparkling citrus: bergamot and ginger up front, orange blossom and green leaves in the middle, and a clean base of rhubarb wood and white musk.

name: Moonlight Patchouli
desc: Patchouli, chocolate and wood open dark and sweet, with rose and iris in the heart. Suede and leather add a smoky, powdery softness.

name: Detour Noir
desc: Sparkling bergamot, mandarin and pepper give way to violet and jasmine, then a creamy, woody base of sandalwood, patchouli and vanilla.

name: Narcisse Noir
desc: A heady floral led by jonquil and orange blossom, with orange and jasmine at its core, drying down to vetiver and sandalwood.

name: J'Ose
desc: Mint, lemon and bergamot open crisp, then coffee and lavender add a dark herbal turn before a sweet, woody base of tonka bean, vanilla and sandalwood.

name: Reaction
desc: Lime, melon and apple stay light and juicy, with lily of the valley at the centre and a soft musk and sandalwood finish.

name: Duro
desc: Leather opens dry and dark, with smoke in the heart. Spice and wood keep it smoky and leathery.

name: Sì Passione
desc: Blackcurrant and bergamot sparkle over rose and jasmine. Cedarwood and patchouli ground this fruity floral in a woody base.

name: La Tulipe
desc: A green, airy floral: cyclamen, freesia and rhubarb around a tulip heart, with blonde woods and vetiver below.

name: Habanita
desc: Raspberry, peach and orange blossom brighten a powdery heart of iris, lilac and heliotrope, closing in leather, benzoin and vanilla.

name: Replica On a Date
desc: A warm, fruity evening scent with a blackcurrant liquor accord, bergamot and pink pepper, a heart of rose, geranium and davana, and patchouli, vetiver, moss and musks below.

name: Oajan
desc: Honey, cinnamon and osmanthus open sweet and spiced. Amber, labdanum and benzoin deepen it, with vanilla, tonka bean and patchouli in a resinous base.

name: Sweet Like Candy
desc: A fruity-floral sweet scent: blackberry, bergamot and pear at the top, white flowers in the heart, then cassis, marshmallow, soft woods and vanilla below.

name: Man Extreme
desc: Bergamot and cactus open fresh, followed by freesia, cardamom and amber. Benzoin, vetiver and wood make a warm, spiced base.

name: Dark Purple
desc: Plum and orange open a fruity rose heart that adds geranium, patchouli and red berries. Grey amber, teakwood and musk close it with a dusky, sweet and woody finish.

name: Royal Amber
desc: Bergamot and green leaves brighten a sweet melon and pineapple heart, which melts into amber, vanilla and gentle musk.

name: Blue Jeans
desc: Galbanum, juniper and citrus make a green, fresh start, with violet, lavender and jasmine behind them. Iris, musk and soft woods leave a powdery finish.

name: Eilish No. 2
desc: Apple blossom and bergamot brighten a dry heart of papyrus, poppy and pepper, which settles into ebony wood, palo santo and vanilla.

name: Dior Homme Intense
desc: Powdery iris gives way to ambrette's soft, skin-like musk, then settles on smooth cedarwood. Clean, quiet and gently woody.

name: Pear Inc.
desc: A juicy pear accord over a soft cetalox heart and musks, giving a clean, fruity skin scent.

name: Roses Greedy
desc: A fruity, gourmand rose. Mandarin, peach, coconut and blackcurrant meet French rose, jasmine and aquatic flowers, then amber, vanilla, white musk and benzoin sweeten the base.

name: Emblem
desc: Cardamom, clary sage and grapefruit open fresh and green, with cinnamon and violet leaf at the heart. Tonka bean and woody notes warm the end.

name: Flower of Immortality
desc: White peach, silky iris butter and tonka bean make a powdery, fruit-soft scent that dries down to a gentle sweetness.

name: La Vie est Belle Intensément
desc: Bergamot, pink pepper and raspberry brighten a creamy heart of jasmine sambac and orange blossom. Patchouli, iris, benzoin and vanilla make a warm, soft base.

name: Karagoz
desc: Black grape and pineapple come with a bundle of herbs at the top, neroli and jasmine in the middle, then agarwood, vetiver and amber, leaving a dry, woody trail.

name: Mélodie de l'Amour
desc: A white floral built on gardenia, tuberose and jasmine, lifted at the start by peach and broom, and warmed underneath with honey, cedarwood and sandalwood.

name: Reckless Pour Femme
desc: A warm, floral-spiced scent: bergamot and mandarin open it, geranium, rose and neroli follow, and coriander, cinnamon, sandalwood, vanilla and musk close it.

name: Opus I
desc: Cardamom, bitter orange and plum precede a lush bouquet of jasmine, tuberose and rose. Vetiver, sandalwood and frankincense give a deep, creamy woodiness.

name: The Only One
desc: Bergamot and violet brighten a powdery heart of coffee and iris, over a sweet, warm base of patchouli and vanilla.

name: Terracotta
desc: Bergamot and coconut milk open into ylang ylang, jasmine and orange blossom with a tiare accord. Vanilla, benzoin and white musk make it creamy.

name: Shuhrah
desc: Rose and tomato leaf open crisp and green, turning to jasmine and sandalwood before a dark, earthy finish of oud, oakmoss and leather.

name: Wisal Dhahab
desc: A fruity floral: mandarin, apple and pear open brightly, orchid, jasmine and rose fill the middle, and musk, sandalwood and patchouli leave a soft woody base.

name: Haya
desc: A bright fruity floral for women: champagne, strawberry and citrus open, gardenia and jasmine bloom in the heart, and amber, sandalwood and chestnut warm the base.

name: Cologne du Maghreb
desc: A herbal, dry citrus cologne with many top notes, from mandarin and rosemary to lavender, followed by neroli and rose, and finished on cedar, vetiver and labdanum.

name: Hunter Intense
desc: A citrus-and-floral scent: bergamot, pomelo, mandarin and lemon on top, lavender, geranium, ylang ylang and tuberose in the heart, with black pepper and cardamom at the base.

name: 212 Sexy
desc: Mandarin and bergamot open fresh, cardamom and pepper add spice, and sandalwood with vanilla keeps the finish warm and soft.

name: Heliotrope
desc: A sweet, powdery floral with an almond-and-vanilla gourmand side: hawthorn, orange blossom and heliotrope lead into tonka bean, musk and balsam of Peru.

name: Earl Grey & Cucumber
desc: Bergamot gives the Earl Grey its citrus lift, cool cucumber adds a watery green, and beeswax leaves a faint honeyed softness.

name: Boccanera
desc: Pepper, ginger and coconut open spiced and sweet, with jasmine in the heart. Leather, vanilla, chocolate, patchouli and musk make a dark, warm base.

name: Oriental Lounge
desc: An oriental spicy scent: sweet pepper and bergamot start it, red rose and satinwood form the heart, and amber, tonka bean and labdanum make a rich resinous base.

name: Play
desc: Bitter orange and grapefruit are sharp and bright, over amyris and vetiver. Citrus, woody and a little earthy.

name: Le Beau Le Parfum
desc: Bergamot lights the opening before creamy coconut and tonka beans take over, giving a sunny, sweet and relaxed trail.

name: Nuit Étoilée
desc: Lemon, mint and orange are cool and sparkling, with pine and fir balsam at the heart. Tonka bean and immortelle leave a gently sweet trail.

name: Eyes Closed
desc: Spicy and earthy: cardamom and cinnamon, then carrot, ginger and orris butter, over papyrus and patchouli.

name: Olibanum
desc: An incense-led scent: orange blossom at the top, frankincense and myrrh at the core, on a base of sandalwood.

name: Valaya
desc: A luminous white-floral musk: bergamot, mandarin and white peach, then orange blossom, finishing on musks, vanilla and vetiver.

name: Colony
desc: Bergamot, pineapple and orange open bright, with jasmine, rose, nutmeg and clove. Leather, patchouli, vetiver and amber give a spiced, warm base.

name: R.E.M.
desc: A dreamy gourmand: quince, fig, salted caramel and marshmallow lead, pear and lavender blossom add a soft floral centre, and tonka, white musk and sandalwood close it.

name: Omnia Coral
desc: Goji berry and bergamot brighten hibiscus and water lily. Pomegranate and cedarwood add a light fruitiness and a clean, woody finish.

name: Incident Diplomatique
desc: A woody, dry scent: mandarin opens it, vetiver and nutmeg make the middle, and patchouli with sandalwood form the base.

name: Starry Nights
desc: Bergamot and lemon brighten a heart of rose, jasmine and patchouli leaves. Amber, vanilla and white musk give a smooth, sweet and softly floral dry-down.

name: Sauvage Elixir
desc: A dense blend of spice and lavender resting on woody depth. Herbal, warm and concentrated, with a fresh edge that lingers around the spice.

name: Vert Fougère
desc: Grapefruit and lavender are crisp and herbal, over a soft amber base. A clean, green fougère feel.

name: Psychedelic Love
desc: A resinous, sweet rose: bergamot and rose with myrrh, vanilla, patchouli and heliotropin, lightened with hedione.

name: Midnight Oud
desc: A smoky, woody scent: birch and rose open, cedar, oud and patchouli form the core, and guaiac wood with cetalox closes it.

name: Explorer Extreme
desc: Bergamot's brightness meets earthy patchouli, and a warm amber accord rounds it out.

name: Trésor Midnight Rose
desc: Raspberry and blackcurrant brighten a rose and jasmine heart, which settles into soft vanilla and musk. Fruity, floral and sweet.

name: Sultan Vetiver
desc: A vetiver study from several origins: Javanese, Bourbon, Haitian and Brazilian. Absinthe, schinus molle, bergamot, neroli, tonka, amberwood and leather support it. Green, earthy and smooth.

name: Futur
desc: A floral-woody extrait: neroli and bergamot open it, jasmine, ylang ylang and violet form the heart, and vetiver, cedar and patchouli close it.

name: Apex Pour Homme
desc: A huge, layered composition: bright citrus and jasmine open it, then a very long base mixes galbanum, oakmoss, tobacco, rum, sandalwood, resins, leather and musk.

name: Cinéma
desc: Cyclamen, mandarin and almond open sweetly, leading into amaryllis, jasmine and peony. Amber, musk and vanilla close it in a warm, creamy glow.

name: Cap Camarat
desc: A sunny, creamy coastal scent: pink pepper and a crisp apple note, ylang ylang and jasmine in the middle, then a resinous base of sandalwood, benzoin, patchouli and labdanum.

name: Cristal
desc: Bergamot, freesia and orange blossom lead to rose, jasmine and musk. Cedarwood, cashmere wood and benzoin make a creamy, woody base.

name: Dahn Al Oudh Moattaq
desc: Turkish rose and oud sit side by side, resinous and warm, with amber and a soft powdery musk drawing the edges together.

name: Eclaire
desc: A confectionery gourmand built on caramel, milk and sugar, with honey and white flowers in the heart and a creamy vanilla, praline and musk base.

name: Daisy Ever So Fresh
desc: Mandarin, mango and pineapple make a bright, juicy opening, softening to rose and orange blossom. Cashmere wood leaves a smooth finish.

name: Orange Star
desc: A juicy, clean citrus-floral: mandarin and clementine sparkle over lemongrass and orange flower, then drift into a soft base of ambergris, tonka bean and vanilla.

name: Rose Prick
desc: A spiced rose: Bulgarian rose and turmeric with patchouli and Sichuan pepper, finished by roasted tonka and balsam.

name: Eau de Toilette Spicebomb Fresh
desc: Pink pepper and pepper spark over lavender, elemi and a touch of salt, drying down to tobacco, moss and amber. Crisp, spicy and herbal.

name: Volutes
desc: Tobacco, honey and dried fruits glow beside iris, with saffron, hay and pepper in the heart. Myrrh, benzoin and styrax add a spiced resinous warmth.

name: L'Eau d'Issey Pure
desc: Sea notes are clean and airy, opening onto jasmine, lily, rose and orange blossom. Ambergris and cashmere wood add a creamy, soft glow.

name: Rare Carbon
desc: A spicy, leathery woody scent for men, with cinnamon and nutmeg over rose, violet and cedar, drying down to vetiver, sandalwood and amber.

name: Vicolo Fiori
desc: A soft, juicy floral: mandarin and campanula over water lily, lotus, cyclamen and white peach, with a powdery base of iris, sandalwood and musk.

name: Basil & Neroli
desc: Basil and neroli pair green herbal freshness with a soft floral heart. Musk lends a smooth, creamy finish.

name: Seminalis
desc: Carnation opens spicy-sweet, with lily of the valley and raspberry. Cedarwood, leather, sandalwood and vanilla give a sugared, woody base.

name: Million Gold For Her
desc: Rose and a white-flower bouquet meet a clean, mineral musk. Soft, bright and quietly creamy.

name: Sel de Vétiver
desc: A woody aromatic with a salty edge: cardamom and grapefruit open, Haitian vetiver, patchouli and geranium lead the heart, and sea salt, iris and ylang-ylang sit underneath.

name: Collection Extraordinaire Santal Blanc
desc: Mandarin and fig open onto powdery violet and sandalwood, ending in a soft, sweet drydown of musk and tonka bean.

name: Oudh 36
desc: Ylang-ylang and rose lie over a dense, resinous base of labdanum, amber and benzoin, with patchouli and cedarwood adding depth.

name: Fleur de Rocaille
desc: A powdery white-floral where gardenia and orange blossom open onto rose and lily of the valley, resting on cedar and sandalwood.

name: La Belle Le Parfum
desc: Pear's soft juiciness meets a smooth vanilla and tonka bean for a sweet, warm and simple trio.
Peppery juniper opens to leather, orris and violet, resting on black amber, patchouli and vanilla for a smooth, slightly dark finish.

name: Confetto
desc: Anise and almond start sweet and sugared, over an amber heart. Vanilla and musk make a warm, soft finish.

name: Fierce Cologne
desc: Lemon, orange and fir balsam feel crisp and resinous. Jasmine, rosemary and lily of the valley follow, settling into oakmoss, musk and vetiver.

name: Arancia di Capri
desc: Mandarin, orange and lemon open juicy and bright, with petitgrain and cardamom adding a green, spicy lift. Musk and caramel give the base a soft, faintly sweet finish.

name: Arancia Di Capri La Riserva
desc: A bright Mediterranean citrus: blood orange and mandarin open over rosemary, basil and a salty mineral touch, then dry down to cedar and soft suede.

name: Blu Mediterraneo Arancia di Capri
desc: Orange, mandarin and lemon give a sunny, sparkling opening, with petitgrain and cardamom adding a touch of green spice. Caramel and musk close it soft, sweet and clean.

name: Buongiorno
desc: A bright herbal wake-up: lemon, spearmint and rosemary give way to lavandin and petitgrain before a clean base of cedar, amber and musk.

name: Buongiorno Al Bacio
desc: Light and kind to the skin: bergamot and rosemary lead into orange blossom and neroli, resting on musk and pale woods.

name: Buongiorno Amore Mio
desc: A soft, laundered cloud: sparkling bergamot and aldehydes over cotton, iris and a hedione glow, closing on musks and an ambroxan trail.

name: Buongiorno Buonanotte
desc: A calm, powdery evening wood: bergamot and pink pepper melt into iris and guaiac, then settle on cedar, musk and cashmere wood.

name: Buongiorno Dolce Far Niente
desc: Lemony and unhurried: citrus peels brighten a heart of lemon and fig wood, ending on cedar, musk and sticky labdanum.

name: Buongiorno Gioco Del Destino
desc: Golden and playful: mandarins and orange open onto wheat, ginger and benzoin, ending in a smooth base of musk, sandalwood and balsam.

name: Colonia
desc: The classic cologne shape: lemon, orange and bergamot over lavender, rosemary and verbena, with a little rose. Vetiver, sandalwood and patchouli add a dry, earthy base that keeps it crisp.

name: Colonia Il Profumo
desc: The classic cologne gently deepened: bergamot, grapefruit and blood orange over rosemary and ylang-ylang, anchored by vetiver and patchouli.

name: Colonia Pura
desc: Bergamot, orange and petitgrain feel clean and sunny, with coriander and jasmine sambac in the middle and cedarwood and musk below.

name: Crystal Incense
desc: Spicy and shimmering: grapefruit, black pepper and ginger lift cardamom, settling on patchouli, benzoin and musk.

name: Fico di Amalfi
desc: Lemon, bergamot and grapefruit sit over green fig, pink pepper and jasmine, drying into fig wood, cedarwood and benzoin.

name: Gelsomino A Freddo
desc: Jasmine served cold: lemon, pink pepper and artemisia frame jasmine, tea and iris, with guaiac, patchouli and cypriol underneath.

name: Gelsomino A Freddo Ambrosia
desc: A richer take on chilled jasmine: cardamom, lemon and frankincense over jasmine, tea, iris and myrrh, finishing on sandalwood, vetiver and cedar.

name: Mandarino Di Sicilia
desc: Sweet-sharp citrus grove: mandarin, bergamot, lemon and blood orange over petitgrain and spearmint, finishing soft on patchouli, cedar and musk.

name: Mandorlo di Sicilia
desc: Almond sits at the centre, soft and slightly sweet, with ylang-ylang adding a floral glow. Bergamot, anise and orange lift the start, while vanilla, balsam and musk make the base creamy.

name: Mirto Di Panarea La Riserva
desc: A Mediterranean herb garden: cedrat, sage and juniper lead to myrtle, lavender and myrrh, finishing on patchouli, labdanum and mastic.

name: Note Di Colonia I
desc: An airy cologne with a floral turn: bergamot and neroli meet lavender, rose and a violet accord over patchouli and cedar.

name: Note Di Colonia Ii
desc: Citrus-forward and cleanly woody: bergamot, orange and grapefruit with cardamom and basil, then sandalwood, guaiac, musk and vetiver.

name: Note Di Colonia Iii
desc: A warmer cologne: mandarin and ginger open onto vetiver, frankincense and jasmine, finishing with tonka bean, myrrh and cistus.

name: Note Di Colonia Iv
desc: Citrus and rose with a resinous glow: bergamot and green mandarin, Turkish rose and orange flower, then opoponax, labdanum and patchouli.

name: Note Di Colonia V
desc: Crisp and dry: Calabrian lemon, bergamot and pink pepper warmed by ginger and juniper, over sandalwood and cedar.

name: Quercia
desc: A citrus-to-forest walk: lemon, bergamot and petitgrain, then cardamom, geranium and cedar, ending on tonka bean, patchouli and oakmoss.

name: Sandalo
desc: Fresh citrus meets creamy wood: bergamot, lemon and orange with lavender and cardamom, resting on sandalwood, amber and tonka bean.

name: Yuzu
desc: Sparkling yuzu with a light floral heart of lotus, mimosa and jasmine, finishing on soft musk, liquorice and sandalwood.

name: Zafferano
desc: Sunny spice and flowers: mandarin, bergamot and coriander over jasmine sambac, saffron and rose, finishing on vanilla, tonka bean and patchouli.

name: Zafferano Ambrosia
desc: Saffron-led and golden: mandarin, bergamot and ginger over saffron, orange flower and jasmine, then vanilla, patchouli and an amber accord.

name: 9 AM
desc: Mandarin, cardamom and pink pepper open bright and spiced, lavender, orange blossom, rose and apple bloom in the heart, and cedarwood, oakmoss, patchouli and musk settle in.

name: 9 AM Dive
desc: Lemon, pink pepper, mint and blackcurrant open cool and juicy, apple, incense and cedarwood take the heart, and patchouli, jasmine, ginger and sandalwood close woody and warm.

name: 9 PM
desc: A bright, spiced opening of apple, cinnamon, lavender and bergamot gives way to orange blossom and lily of the valley, before tonka bean, vanilla, amber and patchouli close sweet and warm.

name: 9 PM Rebel
desc: Sweet and woody, with mandarin and apple on top, cedarwood and vanilla in the middle, and a warm caramel and musk base.

name: Adwaa Al Sharq
desc: Saffron, jasmine and caramel begin warm and sweet, amberwood, ambergris and musk give the heart a clean glow, and fir balsam, cedarwood and musk close soft and resinous.

name: Delicious Bouquet
desc: Lemon, vanilla and bergamot begin sweet and bright, orange blossom, honey, rum and sugar make a rich heart, and tonka bean, musk, caramel and vanilla close warm.

name: Ebdaa Concentrated Perfume Oil
desc: Mandarin and bergamot sparkle, blackcurrant, raspberry and amber make a fruity heart, and cedarwood, vanilla and powdery notes leave a soft base.

name: Edict Amberythme
desc: Cinnamon and tonka bean warm amber from the top, saffron, jasmine and vanilla fill the heart, and sandalwood, cedarwood and ambergris leave a sweet, woody base.

name: Edict Musctique
desc: Cardamom and musk open with soft, spiced warmth; a heart of vanilla with lily of the valley follows, and oud, mint and musk close with a cool, resinous edge.

name: Historic Olmeda
desc: Grapefruit, juniper, cardamom and pink pepper open sharp and bright, jasmine, nutmeg, cedarwood and bergamot form the heart, and musk, ambergris, apple and patchouli close warm.

name: Historic Sahara
desc: Bergamot, cinnamon and cardamom open warm and bright, elemi, vanilla and sugar sweeten the heart, and musk, almond, tonka bean, praline and ambroxan leave a creamy base.

name: Inara White
desc: Fruit and jasmine start sweet, cedarwood and vanilla warm the heart, and woody notes with amber close dry and soft.

name: Kiaana Crush
desc: Saffron opens the way for passion fruit, patchouli and oud, then incense, cedarwood, musk, ambroxan and vanilla leave a resinous, warm base.

name: La Fleur Bouquet
desc: Orange blossom, jasmine and peony open soft, lychee, peach and bergamot sweeten the heart, and musk, oakmoss and Petalia close creamy and light.

name: Lynked Forever
desc: Mandarin and wild berries start juicy, gardenia, tuberose and ylang-ylang bloom in the heart, and coconut, sandalwood, musk and wood close creamy.

name: Malak
desc: Marshmallow, lemon and apple sweeten the opening, musk, coconut and orange blossom make a soft heart, and amber, vanilla and sugar close warm.

name: Mirsaal of Trust
desc: Vetiver and Ambrofix open with an earthy lift, saffron and raspberry bring a fruity spice, and amber, carnation and cashmere wood close warm.

name: Modest Deux
desc: Raspberry and blackcurrant meet rose, then peony and jasmine add a gentle spice before cedarwood, patchouli and musk settle underneath.

name: Modest Une
desc: Bergamot, pepper and lavender open crisp, pink pepper, geranium and elemi warm the heart, and ambroxan, vetiver and patchouli leave an earthy base.

name: Mystique Bouquet
desc: Lychee, bergamot, mandarin and peach open bright, peony, mahonia, vetiver and orange blossom bloom in the heart, and oakmoss, vanilla, musk and ambroxan close soft.

name: Ornament pour Femme
desc: Passion fruit, coconut, peach and bergamot open tropical, orange blossom and vetiver anchor the heart, and amber, vanilla and musk finish sweet and warm.

name: Ornament pour Homme
desc: Apple, lavandin and geranium start green and bright, sandalwood, patchouli and amber warm the heart, and cedarwood, musk and oakmoss finish earthy.

name: Ornament Purple
desc: Mandarin, raspberry and grapefruit open juicy, toffee, white flowers, anise and cardamom give a sweet, spiced heart, and musk, vanilla and patchouli close soft.

name: Oud Rising
desc: Oud, cypress and orange blossom open dark and green, rosewood, cardamom and amber build a spiced heart, and vetiver, musk and tonka bean leave a warm base.

name: Paris Oud
desc: Orange, lemon and blackcurrant start bright, wood, ylang-ylang and amber warm the heart, and powdery notes, musk and tonka bean leave a soft base.

name: Patchouli on Fire
desc: Spicy, aromatic and woody notes open, patchouli, lavender and citrus fill the heart, and patchouli with spicy notes closes earthy and dry.

name: Portrait Abstract
desc: Vetiver, rhubarb and incense open dry and tart, rose and tonka bean soften the heart, and sandalwood, leather, cedarwood and amber leave a warm, woody base.

name: Portrait Revival
desc: Cinnamon, honey, saffron and incense open warm and sweet, tonka bean, oakwood and praline deepen the heart, and dates, sandalwood, caramel and chocolate make a rich base.

name: Rare Passion
desc: Orange, musk and rose open soft, amber, wood and vanilla warm the heart, and rose, musk and orange blossom close floral and clean.

name: Rare Reef
desc: Blackcurrant, grapefruit and mint sparkle over apricot, basil and rose. Fig and dates add a soft, fruity depth at the base. Fresh, herbal and bright.

name: Souvenir Blooming Bliss
desc: Vanilla opens sweet, coconut, palo santo and caramel make a creamy heart, and musk and sandalwood close soft and warm.

name: Souvenir Desert Rose
